who.value: seller running a paid Spotlight campaign, likely Pro

job.value: check how a Spotlight campaign is performing and adjust it

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Spotlight insights' with 'Active (Week 2/4)', '120/129 clicks' and a Performance chart make the purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: For an insights page the clicks progress bar and '120 overall clicks' lead, with 'Edit campaign' as the one action.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Edit campaign' and '5 listings >' are clear, but the '⋮' menu and the round '<' '>' arrows are unlabelled.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Premium slot', 'Standard slot', 'Keyword' and 'Run until all clicks reached' are shown without explanation.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks no decisions; editing is behind 'Edit campaign'.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The stacked bar chart's pink/grey/blue segments only map to the slot breakdown below by colour, and the full 'Setup' card is shown up front.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is about this one running campaign.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Numbers and short labels carry it; no paragraphs.
